sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the complete direct-static requirement: applicability is explicitly selected by sewageDischargeUsesTreatmentPlant, all required ship-level approval and compliance checks are present in the true branch, and both required discharge distances are recorded on each dischargeDistanceRecords node with the canonical nautical-mile unit. Deterministic validation is valid and no semantic repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add the missing ship-level nltl:marpolAnnexIvRegulation9Point1Point1Or9Point2Point1CertificationStatus check in the true applicability branch, constrained to the approved evidence state. The candidate currently omits the required MARPOL Annex IV 9.1.1-or-9.2.1 certification obligation, so it does not faithfully encode the composite requirement.

The COMPLETE dependency contract declares nltl:marpolCertificationStatus and nltl:marpolDischargeStatus in directConstraintTerms, but the candidate omits both. Add ship-level checks for these declared MARPOL status properties in the true applicability branch, using the canonical evidenceStateApproved value for marpolCertificationStatus and the required compliant boolean value for marpolDischargeStatus, without relocating or duplicating the existing specific regulation checks.

The candidate faithfully encodes the complete direct-static requirement: applicability is explicitly selected by sewageDischargeUsesTreatmentPlant, all required ship-level approval and compliance checks are present in the true branch, and both required discharge distances are recorded on each dischargeDistanceRecords node with the canonical nautical-mile unit. Deterministic validation is valid and no semantic repair is required.
